input.installation_name: U.S. Army Reserve Centers, Northern Plains Cluster
input.location: Minnesota, North Dakota and South Dakota (12 base sites; contracting office Fort Snelling, MN)
input.contract_name: Custodial, Grounds Maintenance and Snow and Ice Removal Services - U.S. Army Reserve Centers, Northern Plains Cluster
input.notes: FFP. Base period 1 April 2027 - 31 March 2028 plus four 12-month option periods (Option Period 4 ends 31 March 2032); FAR 52.217-8 extension up to six months is not an option period (evaluated at Option Period 4 rates). Growing season 1 May - 15 October (PWS 5.5); snow season 15 October - 30 April, on call (PWS 5.6). Supports 89th Readiness Division, U.S. Army Reserve Command. 12 base sites in MN, ND, SD plus one optional site (Watertown USARC, SD033, Section B line O-1). Pricing estimates: 16 improved mowing, 8 trimming, 2 edging, 3 semi-improved mowing events per season; 18 plowing and 24 sidewalk clearing/salting events per site per season; BA weekend Sunday service approx. 12 per year at buildings marked BA Wknd Y.
